summary: Aptevo Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) amending its existing at-the-market offering with Roth Capital Partners as sales agent. It revises the amount sellable to up to $2,309,834, constrained by Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6, which caps primary offerings at one-third of public float in any 12-month period while float remains below $75 million. Public float is $6,929,502 based on 2,665,193 non-affiliate shares, and the last reported price is $1.34. This is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation.
